title: Shanmukhamurty
provenance: Goa Velha on the hill above the sulbhatt (TALAD).
detailed_description: Ornamental image of Goa Shanmukhamurty broken below the waist line. Hands are broken. Five faces are shown in the front and the sixth face is positioned at the back. Heads are embelished with jathamukutha and the neck with necklaces. The main face is badly damaged.
